description: This file defines a Java class CorrelationIdEnsuringDirective that provides a custom Akka HTTP directive to ensure each request has a correlation ID. It extracts the correlation ID from request headers or generates a new UUID if none exists, facilitating traceability in request handling.

classes.name: CorrelationIdEnsuringDirective
classes.description: A utility class providing an Akka HTTP directive to ensure requests contain a correlation ID, adding one if missing.

methods.name: ensureCorrelationId
methods.description: Public static method that wraps a route to ensure it has a correlation ID, extracting it from request headers or creating a new one.

methods.name: getCorrelationIdFromHeaders
methods.description: Private static method to retrieve the correlation ID from request headers, or return an empty Optional if not present.

methods.name: createNewCorrelationId
methods.description: Private static method to generate a new UUID-based correlation ID, logging its creation.
